summary: Frontend-only regression + Go Live modal (playlist selector, health-idle, archive library) verified for iteration 31. All requested testids present and functional. License activation flow requires legal acknowledgment checkbox + 'Agree & Enter Studio' button (which have no data-testid; not a regression from this iteration).

issues: Legal-agree checkbox and 'Agree & Enter Studio' button have no data-testid; agents must fall back to CSS/text selectors.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add data-testid=legal-accept-checkbox and data-testid=legal-accept-button on LicenseGate to make license flow fully testid-driven.

(Nice-to-have) Fix pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (a lucide icon is being rendered inside a <select><option>). Repro: always logged to console after any page load. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: GoLiveModal.js props list is very long (17 props). Consider grouping schedule/archive/health related props into sub-objects to keep the surface tidy.

previewBroadcast in GoLiveModal.js awaits onGetBroadcastUrl(b) which may return null (fake/missing blob). Handled gracefully (setPlayId(null)), but the audio element only mounts when playUrl is truthy — good, no crash observed with fake seed.

Broadcasts state initializes lazily from localStorage on App mount. If localStorage is written after mount, the seed will not appear until reload — expected React behavior; test instructions correctly say 'reload and re-enter'.
seed_data_creation: localStorage.hotlive95_broadcasts seeded with one fake entry id=testbc1 (2 MB webm) — deleted at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: License flow: fill [data-testid=license-key-input] with 'Q61VKG819N40K1BH226T', click [data-testid=license-activate-button], then TICK the legal checkbox (input[type=checkbox] on the LicenseGate page) and click button with text 'Agree & Enter Studio'. To seed archive: set localStorage then reload BEFORE unlocking (App reads localStorage lazily at mount). Playlist creation: click [data-testid=new-playlist-button] → fill input[placeholder="Playlist name"] → press Enter.
verified_behaviours: REGRESSION: App loads with only 1 pre-existing benign hydration warning (unrelated to this iteration's changes); no getBroadcastHealth errors.

AUTO DJ HANDOFF: [data-testid=go-live-schedule-playlist] lists user playlists; arming with a playlist + future datetime shows [data-testid=go-live-scheduled] containing 'plays "TEST Show"'; [data-testid=go-live-cancel-schedule] clears it.

ARCHIVE LIBRARY: With seed present, [data-testid=go-live-archive] renders; [data-testid=go-live-archive-item-testbc1] shows shortened name '2026-06-01 20-00.webm' + '2.0 MB'; play/download/delete testids present; play click does not crash even with no blob; delete removes item AND persists across close/reopen (localStorage becomes []).
BROADCAST HEALTH: [data-testid=go-live-health] absent when idle (as expected).
START VALIDATION: [data-testid=go-live-start] disabled when password empty, enabled after typing password. [data-testid=go-live-close] closes modal. No real broadcast attempted.
